title: Replay a paid chart-635 relay and locate its displaced owners
body:
## Mathematical result

A three-slot paid rewrite sends x549 through 490 and 635 to the chart-1 sink. The fourth changed incidence restores displaced owner 639 and all 537 chart-1 outputs, preserving owners 221, 411 and 679. The complete operators still fail 90 forward and 34 adjoint rows, including new failures at owners 662 and 664. Its complete BIT price would yield +0.6853938386 at 0.00388 if the word were corrected. A named 410-case census tracks every first-reader or displaced terminal failure under fixed branch stocks.

## Sources

Canonical main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. #7830 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15 and #8006 4035f150285513852cab8d00b8bfc233c699ea0a. #8005 concerns unchanged history and direct receiver replacements. This package physically rebinds multiple incidences.

## Validation

A fresh extraction passed 22 hashes, isolated verify.py, both native operators, full signed invoices, two literal controls and the local 410-position census.

## Open next questions

Restore the displaced directions as well as the older diagnostic defects and bind the whole finite application.
